# HerAmbition

> HerAmbition is a premier women's leadership and career community empowering women through practical programs, mentorship, and professional networks. Tagline: "Lead with Grace & Impact. More Women. Brighter Futures."

## Mission & Purpose
HerAmbition empowers women at every milestone of their professional journey—whether restarting after a career pause, accelerating into executive and director positions, or scaling innovative business ventures. With 500+ active members, HerAmbition provides actionable 4-6 week cohort-based accelerator tracks, 1-on-1 mentorship, career readiness toolkits, and an active community.

## Core Programs
- **The Becoming (Career Strategy)**: For women restarting or realigning their careers. Focuses on core strengths assessment, high-impact CV and LinkedIn positioning, executive presence, and strategic negotiation. (Duration: 4 - 6 Weeks)
- **HerInfluence (Leadership Development)**: For mid to senior women professionals stepping into management, director, and VP roles. Focuses on authentic leadership, cross-functional influence, high-stakes decision making, and executive sponsorship. (Duration: 4 - 6 Weeks)
- **The FoundHer (Entrepreneurship & Business Growth)**: For aspiring and early-stage women founders. Covers problem validation, unit economics, go-to-market strategies, and investor pitch architecture. (Duration: 4 - 6 Weeks)

## Career Readiness Track
A tactical, hands-on initiative tailored to prepare women for modern job markets:
- Resume & LinkedIn Makeover
- Interview Readiness & Executive Framing
- Career Clarity & Strategic Direction
- Ongoing Peer & Mentor Support
